title: Settings
description: Your profile, preferences and account security. Changes follow you to every device.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.description: Choose how Personalitify looks and which language it speaks.
appearance.themeDescription: System follows the setting of your device.
appearance.languageDescription: Used for the interface, emails and notifications.

region.title: Date and time
region.description: Your day starts and ends in your time zone. Habits, streaks and reminders follow it.
region.detected: This device is in the time zone {{zone}}.
region.timeZoneDescription: Decides when a day begins for your habits and statistics.
region.weekStartDescription: Used by calendars and weekly statistics.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description: Choose what Personalitify may remind you about.
notifications.inAppDescription: Turn off to silence everything below.
notifications.habitRemindersDescription: At the times you set for each habit.
notifications.taskRemindersDescription: When a task is due or overdue.
notifications.goalRemindersDescription: When a target date is approaching.
notifications.achievementsDescription: When you earn a badge or reach a new level.
notifications.quietHoursDescription: No reminders are delivered during this period. They wait until it ends.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.description: Your journal and mood entries are visible only to you.
privacy.hidePreviewsDescription: Journal and mood text is not shown in summaries and notifications.
privacy.exportDescription: Download everything Personalitify stores about you as a JSON file.

security.passwordDescription: Changing your password signs out all your other devices.
security.passwordChanged_one: Password changed. {{count}} other session was signed out.
security.passwordChanged_other: Password changed. {{count}} other sessions were signed out.
security.sessionsDescription: Devices that are currently signed in to your account.
security.signOutEverywhereDescription: Every device, including this one, will need to sign in again.
security.activityDescription: Sign-ins and changes to your account in the last 180 days.

actions.auth_refresh_token_reuse: Session closed after a suspicious token reuse

devices.title: Devices
devices.description: Applications and browsers that have signed in to your account.
devices.name: Device name
devices.removeDescription: The device is signed out and removed from your account. It can sign in again later.

sync.never: This device has not synchronized yet

account.title: Delete account
account.description: Permanently removes your account and everything in it. This cannot be undone.
account.deleteWarning: All your habits, goals, tasks, journal entries and settings will be erased permanently. Consider downloading your data first.
